facts.business: Ambica Agarbathies Aroma & Industries Limited manufactures and sells agarbathies (incense sticks) and related aroma products.

auditor.name: Ramasamy Koteswara Rao and Co LLP

facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions were on an arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business. No materially significant related party transactions were made with Promoters, Directors, Key Managerial Personnel or other designated persons which may have a potential conflict with the interest of the Company at large. Transactions are placed before the Audit Committee and Board for approval. Prior omnibus approval of the Audit Committee is obtained for foreseen and repetitive transactions. The Company has developed a Policy on Related Party Transactions for identification and monitoring. Particulars of contracts or arrangements with related parties referred to in Section 188(1) of the Companies Act, 2013 in Form AOC-2 is annexed as Annexure V.
